resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code; suitable for spin-polarized DFT+vdW.

resources.notes: The agent must install and use Quantum ESPRESSO to perform the rigid-shift scans.

resources.name: Planar phthalocyanine (Pc) geometry

access.notes: Planar phthalocyanine macrocycle atomic coordinates (C, N, H). Standard bond lengths are well known; the agent can construct the geometry from literature values or retrieve a reference structure from public databases (e.g., NIST, COD).

resources.notes: Planar Pc macrocycle geometry, reconstructible from known bond lengths. The exact coordinates are not critical; they must be planar and have the correct connectivity.

resources.name: SSSP pseudopotential library (PBE, PAW)

access.notes: Library of verified PAW pseudopotentials for PBE exchange-correlation. Contains Zr and light-element pseudopotentials.

resources.notes: Pseudopotentials required for QE calculations with PBE functional.

resources.name: Grimme D2 van der Waals correction

access.notes: Activated in QE via input_dft='PBE+D2'. No separate download needed.

resources.notes: The D2 correction is part of Quantum ESPRESSO's available functionals.
